simple.meaning: שְׂעֹרָה (sᵉʻôrâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “barley (as villose).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 34 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Exodus 9:31. Its contexts include family line, offering, Torah, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂעֹרָה (H8184).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שְׂעֹרָה (sᵉʻôrâh) / H8184 is traced through Exodus 9:31, Leviticus 27:16, Numbers 5:15, Deuteronomy 8:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H8184. seorah שְׂעֹרָה noun feminine barley ( bearded grain; ᵐ5 κριθή , ᵑ9 hordeum; Late Hebrew id. ; Sabean שערם Glas in Fell ZMG liv (1900), 256 , Arabic ; Old Aramaic סְעָרְתָא ᵑ7 שערה, , Syriac ; Di 260 compare Ethiopic wheat, grain ); — absolute ׳שׂ Exod 9:31 +; usually plural שְׂעֹרִים Hosea 3:2 +; — barley , common grain (often || חִטָּה , etc.): 1 growing, standing , singular Exod 9:31 (twice in verse) (J), Deut 8:8 ; Job 31:40 ; 1:11 , as sown Isa 28:25 ; standing, plural 2Sam 14:30 ׳שְׂעוֺ 1Chr 11:13 , reaped (הַ)שְׂעֹרִים קְצִיר 2Sam 21:9 ; Ruth 1:22 ; 2:23 , הַשּׂ ׳גֹּרֶן 3:2 . 2 plural, the grains, measured, cooked , etc.: Hosea 3:2 (twice in verse); Ezek 4:9 ; 13:19 ; 45:13 ; 2Kin 7:1 , 16 , 18 ; Jer 41:8 ; 2Chr 2:9 ; 2:14 ; 27:5 ; Ruth 2:17 ; 3:15 , 17 ; 2Sam 17:28 ; 1Kin 5:8 (food for horses); שׂ חֹמֶר ׳זֶרַע Lev 27:16 (P); שׂ ׳קֶמַח Num 5:15 , שׂ ׳לֶחֶם Judg 7:13 ; 2Kin 4:42 , שׂ ׳עֻגַת Ezek 4:12 .
